# ADR-NNN: <decision title>
Status       — proposed | accepted | superseded
Context      — the forces: what changed, what hurts,
               what constrains
Decision     — one sentence, active voice, no hedging
Alternatives — each with the reason it lost
               (not a strawman parade)
Consequences — what gets easier, what gets harder,
               what we now operate
Reversal     — the signal that would reopen this,
               and the exit cost today
